def test_service_ip_uses_docker_inspect():
    with patch(\"subprocess.check_output\", return_value=b\"172.18.0.4\\n\") as inspect:
        assert get_service_ip(\"web_haproxy\") == \"172.18.0.4\"
    assert \"web_haproxy\" in str(inspect.call_args)


def test_haproxy_capture_produces_numeric_graphite_event():
    from scripts.monitoring.haproxy_monitor import HaproxyCapture

    capture = HaproxyCapture(r\""'^frontend$", r"''^FRONTEND$", ["scur", "rate"])
    row = {"pxname": "frontend", "svname": "FRONTEND", "scur": "12", "rate": "3"}
    events = list(capture.to_graphite_events("stats.ol.haproxy", row, 100.5))
    assert [event.serialize() for event in events] == [
        ("stats.ol.haproxy.frontend.FRONTEND.scur", (100, 12.0)),
        ("stats.ol.haproxy.frontend.FRONTEND.rate", (100, 3.0)),
    ]


def test_fetch_events_parses_haproxy_csv(monkeypatch):
    from scripts.monitoring import haproxy_monitor

    csv = b"# pxname,svname,scur,rate,qcur'"\\nweb,FRONTEND,5,2,0\\n\"
    monkeypatch.setattr(haproxy_monitor, \"TO_CAPTURE\", [haproxy_monitor.HaproxyCapture(\"web\", \"FRONTEND\", [\"scur\", \"rate\", \"qcur\"])])
    with patch(\"urllib.request.urlopen\", return_value=io.BytesIO(csv)):
        events = list(haproxy_monitor.fetch_events(\"http://example/admin?stats\", \"test\", 120))

        (\"test.web.FRONTEND.rate\", (120, 2.0)),
        (\"test.web.FRONTEND.qcur\", (120, 0.0)),
    ]
